challenges.text: No direct evidence places the accused at the crime scene at the time of occurrence
Eyewitness testimony is unreliable due to poor lighting conditions at the scene
Weapon recovered does not have matching fingerprints or DNA evidence
Alternative perpetrator theory not ruled out by investigation
Medical evidence does not conclusively prove cause of death
Accused has no prior enmity with victim - motive not established
Bloodstains could have been transferred accidentally - no proof of assault
CCTV footage is unclear and does not positively identify the accused
